name: 公開状態と直接アクセス人数を示すリポジトリ可視性カード
prompt:
Recreate the supplied GitHub repository access summary as a faithful Japanese localization. Match the 704 by 240 pixel source crop and its 2.933:1 wide aspect ratio. Use the full horizontal width and preserve the exact side-by-side two-card layout. Keep the canvas white and exclude the left settings navigation, manage-access toolbar, invitation row, and any surrounding screen.

At the upper left, place the bold dark heading 「アクセス権のあるユーザー」 at the same compact size and position as the source heading. Below it, draw two equal pale-gray rounded cards side by side with a narrow gap, matching the source margins, widths, and height. Keep both cards aligned to the same top and bottom edges, with small internal padding.

Left card: at the top, put the small muted monospace label 「公開リポジトリ」 at the left and a small dark eye outline icon at the far right. Under it, show the two-line dark text 「このリポジトリは公開されており、誰でも閲覧できます。」. Beneath the description, place the short blue link 「管理」 at the lower left.

Right card: at the top, put the muted monospace label 「直接アクセス」 at the left and a small two-person outline icon at the far right. Under it, keep exactly two body lines, matching the source rhythm. The first line is one compact dark sentence: 「1人がリポジトリにアクセスできます。」. The second line is the blue clickable summary 「コラボレーター0人。招待1件。」. Keep this whole summary on a single line; preserve the exact counts of zero collaborators and one invitation.

Use compact GitHub settings typography, dark charcoal text, restrained blue links, very pale blue-gray card fill, thin outline icons, and modest rounded corners. Preserve the source whitespace, two-card balance, hierarchy, and small gap. Do not invent extra actions, counts, labels, cards, icons, or decorative graphics. Keep all content inside the 704 by 240 wide crop.
reviewNotes: Version 2 keeps the public-repository description and management link, and fits the direct-access count and collaborator/invitation summary into two body lines. Both cards, labels and icons align closely to the source. Unmodified candidate 2148x732 (2.9344:1) matches 704x240 (2.9333:1) within 0.1%; visual comparison complete.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
